title.en: Feasible options and reasons for exclusion

text.zh: 给二选一之前先穷尽可行选项，被排除的选项说明排除理由。
text.en: Before offering a choice between two options, exhaust the feasible options, and state the reason for each option excluded.

zh: 选择本模板的环境；按正文条件适用
en: Where the template is selected; applies under the conditions in the text

trigger.zh: 要给出二选一的方案或建议之前
trigger.en: Before offering a choice between two options

purpose.zh: 避免没有穷尽可行选项就过早收敛为二选一
purpose.en: Avoid narrowing to two options before the feasible ones are exhausted

exclude.zh: 不需要在多个方案之间选择的问题
exclude.en: Questions that need no choice among options
